values.title: Honest Guidance
values.desc: We tell you when COBRA is the right choice — and when it isn't. Our advisors are paid to help you find the best coverage, not to push the most expensive option.

values.title: Deep Expertise
values.desc: COBRA is all we do. Our team stays current on federal regulations, state mini-COBRA laws, and ACA marketplace rules so you don't have to.

values.title: People First
values.desc: Losing a job or going through a life change is stressful enough. We make the insurance piece straightforward, fast, and human.

values.title: No Pressure
values.desc: There's no obligation when you call us. We answer your questions, explain your options, and let you decide what's right for your situation.

whatWeDo.title: COBRA Enrollment Guidance
whatWeDo.desc: We walk you through every step of electing COBRA — from reading your election notice to making your first payment on time.

whatWeDo.title: Coverage Alternatives
whatWeDo.desc: We compare COBRA against ACA marketplace plans, short-term coverage, and other options so you can make an informed decision.

whatWeDo.title: Ongoing Plan Management
whatWeDo.desc: Questions about payments, dependents, or coverage verification? We help you manage your active COBRA plan from election through expiration.

whatWeDo.title: State-Specific Expertise
whatWeDo.desc: Mini-COBRA laws vary dramatically by state. We know the rules in all 22 states where we're licensed and can tell you exactly what applies to your situation.
